verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents payment sending, batch transfers and card spend controls, but nothing about team roles, approval permissions or one-click approval workflows for designated teammates. Card spending permissions (wise-docs-30, wise-docs-32) are an adjacent card-level control, not payment-approval permissions, so they earn no credit. Approval workflows are a fair axis for a business payments account, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can set up approval permissions so designated teammates can approve and send payments with one click
